unitTitle: An Early Bird or a Night Owl?

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in: at, in or on, then underline the adverbs of frequency.
exercises.instructionUz: at, in yoki on ni qo'ying, so'ng takrorlanish ravishlarini toping.
exercises.explanationUz:
MATN — Sallining shanba kuni.

Salli — o'quvchi, lekin uning KICHIK ISHI ham bor:
gazeta tashiydi ('paper round').
Britaniyada bolalar ertalab gazeta tashib pul topishadi —
bu odatiy hol.

PREDLOG TANLASH:
  soat (half past six, eight o'clock, noon) → AT
  kun qismi (the morning, the evening)      → IN
  kun nomi (Saturdays, Saturday afternoons,
            Saturday night)                 → ON

DIQQAT: 'Saturday NIGHT' — kun nomi bor, shuning uchun ON
('at night' emas!).

lines.textEn: 1) ____ Saturdays, Sally always gets up very early ...
lines.whyUz: Kun nomi → ON Saturdays (= har shanba). Gap boshida katta harf. RAVISH: 'always'.

lines.textEn: First, she has a shower, then she gets dressed.
lines.uz: Avval u dush qabul qiladi, so'ng kiyinadi.

lines.textEn: After that, she goes to the newsagent's to collect the papers.
lines.uz: Shundan keyin u gazetalarni olish uchun gazeta do'koniga boradi.
lines.whyUz: 'the newsagent's' = gazeta va jurnal sotuvchi do'kon. Apostrof 's' — 'sotuvchining do'koni'.

lines.textEn: She finishes her paper round 4) ____ eight o'clock, ...
lines.whyUz: Soat → AT. 'a paper round' = gazeta tashish yo'nalishi.

lines.textEn: ... then she goes home for breakfast.
After breakfast, she usually goes shopping with her mum, and then, 5) ____ noon, she meets her friends.
They sometimes go to the cinema 6) ____ Saturday afternoons.
lines.whyUz: Kun nomi bor → ON ('in the afternoons' EMAS). RAVISH: 'sometimes'.

lines.textEn: She usually has dinner with her family 7) ____ the evening, ...
lines.whyUz: Kun qismi → IN the evening. RAVISH: 'usually'.

lines.textEn: She always goes to bed late 8) ____ Saturday night.
lines.whyUz: Kun nomi bor → ON Saturday night ('at night' EMAS!). RAVISH: 'always'.

exercises.instructionEn: Then underline the adverbs of frequency. What does Sally always/usually/sometimes do during the weekend?
exercises.instructionUz: Takrorlanish ravishlarini toping. Salli dam olish kuni doim / odatda / ba'zan nima qiladi?
exercises.explanationUz:
Matnda BESHTA takrorlanish ravishi bor.
Har birini toping va Salli nima qilishini ayting.

QOLIP:
  Sally ALWAYS + fe'l+S + ...
  She USUALLY + fe'l+S + ...
  They SOMETIMES + fe'l + ...  ('they' ko'plik → -s YO'Q)

items.whyUz: Matndagi birinchi ravish. 'gets up' dan oldin.

items.textEn: She ____ goes shopping with her mum. (75%)
They ____ go to the cinema on Saturday afternoons. (25%)
She ____ has dinner with her family in the evening. (75%)
She ____ goes to bed late on Saturday night. (100%)

items.answer: She always gets up very early and always goes to bed late.
items.whyUz: 'always' bilan ikki ish: erta turadi va kech yotadi.

items.answer: She usually goes shopping with her mum and usually has dinner with her family.
She sometimes goes to the cinema with her friends.
items.whyUz: Matnda 'They sometimes go...' — 'they' = Salli va do'stlari. Salli haqida aytganda 'She goes'.

exercises.instructionEn: What do you always/usually/sometimes do during the weekend?
exercises.instructionUz: Siz dam olish kuni doim / odatda / ba'zan nima qilasiz?
exercises.explanationUz:
O'ZINGIZ haqingizda — fe'l -s OLMAYDI:
  Sally always GETS up. (u)
  I always GET up.      (men)

QOLIP:
  I + RAVISH + fe'l + ... + vaqt.

Dam olish kunlari uchun vaqt iboralari:
  at the weekend  — dam olish kunlari
  on Saturdays    — shanba kunlari
  on Sunday mornings — yakshanba ertalablari

structure.modelEn: I always get up late at the weekend.
I usually have breakfast with my family on Sundays.
I often go out with my friends on Saturday afternoons.
I sometimes go to the cinema on Saturday night.
I rarely do my homework at the weekend.
I never get up early on Sundays.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in do(n't), does(n't), am(not), is(not) or are(not).
exercises.instructionUz: do(n't), does(n't), am(not), is(not) yoki are(not) — birini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
ASOSIY TEKSHIRUV — gapda ODDIY FE'L bormi?

  BOR  → do / does
    Do you LIKE playing football?
    Does James LIKE jazz music?

  YO'Q → am / is / are
    ARE these your shoes?       (ot)
    IS Kirsty a nurse?          (kasb)
    ARE you happy with your life? (sifat)
    ARE you from Egypt?         (kelib chiqish)

EGAGA QARAB:
  I → am / do
  he, she, it → is / does
  you, we, they → are / do

DIQQAT — 'I am not' ning qisqartmasi FAQAT 'I'm not':
  ✅ I'm not      ❌ I amn't

lines.whyUz: Oddiy fe'l bor → DO. 'like' dan keyin -ING.
Sifat bilan 'to be'. 'you' → ARE. 'happy WITH' — predlog shart.

lines.textEn: Yes, I ____ , but my job ____ very tiring.

lines.whyUz: Sifat bilan 'to be'. 'it' → is. 'I agree' = roziman.
Oddiy fe'l + birlik → DOES. Ravish 'often' ega va fe'l orasida.
'I am not' → 'I'm not' (yagona shakl). Keyin 'I am from Canada'.

lines.textEn: Excuse me, ____ that man a doctor?
lines.whyUz: Kasb bilan 'to be'. 'that man' 3-shaxs birlik → IS.

lines.textEn: No, he ____ , but I ____ . How can I help you?
lines.whyUz: 'he' → isn't. 'I' → am (men shifokorman). 'How can I help you?' = qanday yordam bera olaman?

exercises.instructionEn: Put the following into the correct boxes: IN / AT / ON.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagilarni to'g'ri kataklarga joylashtiring: IN / AT / ON.
exercises.explanationUz:
18 TA IBORA, uch guruhga bo'linadi (har birida 6 ta).

RO'YXAT:
  May, spring, Monday, 5 o'clock, the weekend, 1959,
  the evening, 13th May, winter, Friday, the morning,
  night, 11:30, noon, Wednesday morning, 2 o'clock,
  4th January, Tuesday night

QOIDA:
  IN — oy, fasl, yil, kun qismi (kun nomisiz)
  AT — soat, the weekend, night, noon
  ON — hafta kunlari, sanalar, kun nomi bilan kun qismi

ENG CHALKASH JUFTLIKLAR:
  'night' (yolg'iz)        → AT night
  'Tuesday night' (kun nomi bilan) → ON Tuesday night

  'the morning' (yolg'iz)  → IN the morning
  'Wednesday morning' (kun nomi bilan) → ON Wednesday morning

QOIDA: KUN NOMI bo'lsa — DOIM ON.

items.whyUz: SANA → ON. Faqat 'May' bo'lsa IN bo'lardi.
Kun nomi bor → ON. 'the morning' yolg'iz bo'lsa IN bo'lardi.
Kun nomi bor → ON. 'night' yolg'iz bo'lsa AT bo'lardi!

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the cinema noticeboard and, in pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Kinoteatr e'lon taxtasiga qarang va juftlikda namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
THE ODEON CINEMA e'lon taxtasi:
  Screen 1 | Great Expectations  | 2:30
  Screen 2 | Lost in Space       | 2:45
  Screen 3 | Independence Day    | 3:10
  Screen 4 | Titanic             | 3:25
  Screen 5 | Godzilla            | 3:35

'Screen' — kinoteatrdagi zal (ekran).
Katta kinoteatrlarda bir necha zal bo'ladi.

NAMUNA:
  SA: What's on at Screen 1?
  SB: Great Expectations.
  SA: What time does it start?
  SB: It starts at half past two / two thirty.

IKKI IBORA:
  'What's on?' = nima namoyish etilyapti?
  'What time does it start?' = soat nechada boshlanadi?

Vaqtni IKKI XIL ayting — 5-unit qoidasi bo'yicha.

items.question: What's on at Screen 1?
items.answer: Great Expectations. It starts at half past two / two thirty.
items.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna. 'Great Expectations' — Charlz Dikkens romani asosidagi film.

items.question: What's on at Screen 2?
items.answer: Lost in Space. It starts at a quarter to three / two forty-five.
items.whyUz: 45 daqiqa → a quarter TO THREE (soat oshadi).

items.question: What's on at Screen 3?
items.answer: Independence Day. It starts at ten past three / three ten.

items.question: What's on at Screen 4?
items.answer: Titanic. It starts at twenty-five past three / three twenty-five.

items.question: What's on at Screen 5?
items.answer: Godzilla. It starts at twenty-five to four / three thirty-five.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the dialogue then, in pairs, have similar dialogues using the prompts below.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni o'qing, so'ng juftlikda quyidagi so'zlar bilan shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
TAKLIF QILISH VA RAD ETISH dialogi.

UCH IBORA:
  Let's + fe'l (asos)    — kel(ing) ...aylik (taklif)
  I don't want to + fe'l — ...ni xohlamayman (rad etish)
  for a change           — o'zgartirish uchun, boshqacha bo'lsin

MULOYIMLIK QOIDASI:
  Rad etganda ALTERNATIVA taklif qiling —
  shunda suhbat davom etadi va qo'pol chiqmaydi:
    'Oh no, I don't want to ... again!
     Let's ... for a change.'

RAZILIK:
  'That's a good idea.' = Bu yaxshi fikr.

BERILGAN SO'ZLAR:
  • play tennis / Saturday / go fishing
  • play cards / this evening / watch a video

example.speaker: A
example.en: Let's go to the cinema tonight.

example.speaker: B
example.en: Oh no, I don't want to go to the cinema again! Let's go out for dinner for a change.
example.uz: Voy yo'q, yana kinoga borishni xohlamayman! Kel, o'zgartirish uchun kechki ovqatga chiqaylik.

example.speaker: B (2)
example.en: Oh no, I don't want to play tennis again! Let's go fishing for a change.
example.uz: Voy yo'q, yana tennis o'ynashni xohlamayman! Kel, o'zgartirish uchun baliq ovlashga boraylik.

example.speaker: B (3)
example.en: Oh no, I don't want to play cards again! Let's watch a video for a change.
example.uz: Voy yo'q, yana karta o'ynashni xohlamayman! Kel, o'zgartirish uchun video ko'raylik.

wordFormation.introUz: Workbook 22-bet — do'kon nomlari, taklif iboralari va predlog istisnolari.

groups.explanationUz: Britan inglizchasida do'kon nomi egasi bilan aytiladi: 'sotuvchining do'koni'.
Bu iboralar kundalik muloqotda juda ko'p kerak.

items.derived: I don't want to go again.
Let's go out for a change.

groups.explanationUz: Bu qoida barcha istisnolardan ustun turadi.
Britaniyada bolalar gazeta tashib pul topishadi. Bu odatiy birinchi ish.

patterns.exampleEn: On Saturdays, Sally always gets up very early in the morning.
patterns.exampleUz: Shanba kunlari Salli doim juda erta turadi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Vaqt ifodasi gap boshida — keyin vergul.
Ravish fe'ldan oldin turadi.

patterns.formula: ON + kun nomi + night/morning (kun nomi ustun!).
patterns.exampleEn: She always goes to bed late on Saturday night.
patterns.exampleUz: U shanba kechasi doim kech yotadi.
patterns.explanationUz: Kun NOMI bo'lsa ON — 'at night' istisnosi bekor bo'ladi.

patterns.formula: Are/Is + EGA + ot/sifat? ↔ Do/Does + EGA + fe'l?
patterns.exampleEn: Are these your shoes? ↔ Does James like jazz music?
patterns.exampleUz: Bu sizning tuflilaringizmi? ↔ Jeyms jaz musiqani yoqtiradimi?
patterns.explanationUz: Oddiy fe'l bo'lsa do/does, bo'lmasa 'to be'.

patterns.formula: No, he doesn't, BUT Jack does.
patterns.exampleEn: Does George often play football? — No, he doesn't, but Jack does.
patterns.exampleUz: Jorj tez-tez futbol o'ynaydimi? — Yo'q, lekin Jek o'ynaydi.
patterns.explanationUz: 'but' dan keyin fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI — faqat yordamchi qoladi.

patterns.formula: What's on at Screen ...? — ... It starts at + vaqt.
patterns.exampleEn: What's on at Screen 1? — Great Expectations. It starts at half past two.
patterns.exampleUz: 1-zalda nima namoyish etilyapti? — 'Great Expectations'. Soat ikki yarimda boshlanadi.
patterns.explanationUz: 'What's on?' — dastur haqida savol. Vaqt bilan AT.

patterns.formula: Let's + fe'l. — Oh no, I don't want to + fe'l + again! Let's + fe'l + for a change.
patterns.exampleEn: Let's go to the cinema tonight. — Oh no, I don't want to go to the cinema again! Let's go out for dinner for a change.
patterns.exampleUz: Kel, bugun kinoga boraylik. — Voy yo'q, yana kinoga borishni xohlamayman! Kel, o'zgartirish uchun kechki ovqatga chiqaylik.
patterns.explanationUz:
'Let's' dan keyin 'to' YO'Q, 'want' dan keyin 'to' BOR.
Rad etganda ALTERNATIVA taklif qilish — muloyimlik qoidasi.
